rationale: Price gapped up 8.52% and has run to 91.4% of today's range near the session high of $20.05, with the last candle showing a wide spread ($19.86–$20.05) and elevated volume suggesting a potential exhaustion zone rather than a clean continuation setup. The bid-ask spread of 80 bps adds meaningful friction, and entering long near the high of a large gap-up with no pullback to a defined support level (VWAP at $19.46, 9-EMA at $19.24) offers a poor risk/reward; a short against the high is equally unattractive given the strong upward momentum and lack of a confirmed reversal signal.
